serie: Loretta Cooks for One: an 81-year-old widow cooks small suppers for one in her little Iowa farmhouse kitchen, from the recipes of her own little book
acciones: cutting a recipe down to one plate, pressing meat into a muffin tin, spooning egg into a cup, lifting a hot muffin-tin cup out with a fork, wrapping a portion in foil, labeling a freezer bag, eating at her small table for one
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by her grandson with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects of an old Iowa farmhouse kitchen, plain bowls and pans with no labels, no beautiful composition.

loretta.desc: Loretta, an 81-year-old white American grandmother with short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron, with old wrinkled hands

lugares_fijos.cocina: Loretta's small 1950s white farmhouse kitchen: a white enamel stove with chrome handles, yellow gingham curtains on the window, a small wooden cross on the wall, a rooster cookie jar on a dark wooden dresser, a worn wooden table with one chair pulled out
lugares_fijos.mesa: Loretta's small kitchen table set for one: the good plate, a folded paper napkin, a glass of milk, a candle that is not lit, a worn wooden table by the window
lugares_fijos.congelador: the freezer of Loretta's old white kitchen fridge: a stack of freezer bags written on with a marker, a muffin tin and a foil pan on the counter next to it
lugares_fijos.horno: Loretta's old white oven with a glass door, a muffin tin on the rack inside, the light of the oven on the cups

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, age and skin of the elderly woman in the reference photograph. She wears a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron.
